# VC-HB-2100

Manufacturer: Siemens.
Type code: 1FL2104-4AG11-1MC0.
SIMOTICS S-1FL2, 1 kW, with holding brake and multiturn encoder.
SiePortal model. No login was required.

File: `1FL2104-4AG11-1MC0_3D_en.STP` (1814751 bytes).
`load_vendor_shape` is called with `recenter=False`.
File Y = 0 is the flange face. The shaft tip is at file Y = −40 mm.
The body rear is at file Y = 186.6 mm.
`Rot(0, 0, 180)` points the shaft to +Y.
The assembly places the flange face on the gearbox input face.
The shaft then enters the bore.

Measured on this solid:
- Compound of 41 solids. Overall length 226.6 mm, including the 40 mm shaft.
- Flange 81 mm square. Body behind the flange is 186.6 mm.
- Shaft axis is file Y. Shaft radius is 9.5 mm.
- A key solid sits on the shaft, 6 mm by 6 mm, from 15 mm to 40 mm past the flange.
- An oil-seal stack extends about 8 mm past the flange, out to about Ø66 mm.
- The usable IP65 shaft in the Siemens comparison is 19 mm by 32 mm.
- A connector sticks past the 81 mm square on +Z after the rotation.
- Nameplate mass of this type is about 4.1 kg. Do not replace it with the successor mass.

This type is Phase Out Announce.
The Siemens successor is SH40 New, order pattern 1FL2104-4BG□1-□□C0.
Source: Siemens document 109997329, 2026-01-29.
Operating instructions: S200 PN / 1FL2, 06/2026, document 110005040.

Successor compared with this motor:
- Length with brake: 192.6 mm versus 226.6 mm.
- Flange thickness: 8 mm versus 6.4 mm.
- Usable IP65 shaft: 19 mm by 37 mm versus 19 mm by 32 mm.
- Mass: 3.2 kg versus 4.1 kg.
- Successor inertia 0.97 kg·cm². Successor maximum torque 11.2 Nm. Always IP65.
- Unchanged: flange 81 mm square, centering 70 mm, pitch circle 90 mm, four holes Ø6.6 mm.
- Unchanged: shaft 19 h6, key 6 mm by 6 mm by 25 mm, holding brake 3.3 Nm.
- The S200 drive 6SL5510-1BB11-0AA0 stays.

The placed solid shares about 5110 mm³ with the PLE120.
The oil seal is longer than the 4.4 mm centering recess.
The key meets a bore that has no keyway.
The flange faces still meet. The shaft itself clears the Ø19 bore.
Re-check the input adapter. It was configured for 1FL2104-4AG10.
The successor 1FL2104-4BG needs the same check.
